Name: WEP_ABSORP_POS_PARAM_ST
Description: Where a weapon's models (up to four, Model 0-3) attach to the character in each hold state: one-handed in either hand, two-handed, or sheathed. A weapon's row is its EquipParamWeapon Absorp Param ID. Dummy poly values are dummy poly IDs on the character model (retail 20/21 for the hands, 2030 and up for sheath points).

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Unset in retail.
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Sheathe Style
Fields.Description: Sheathe style of the weapon, read by the character's behaviour script (HKS) to choose sheathe and draw animations. Retail 0-3.

Fields.Name: Skeleton Bind
Fields.Description: Set for weapons whose model follows the character's skeleton (retail: the Poisoned and Madding Hand, Dryleaf Arts and Beast Claw rows). While such a weapon is sheathed it gets no attachment point (the Sheathed dummy polys are ignored).
Padding.
